paite: Na kiang ah ka lungtang teng in kipahthu ka gen ding a; pathiante ma ah nang phat in la ka sa ding hi.
heading: David La / Kipahthu Genna Thumna
english: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

paite: Na tempul siangthou lam nga in ka hon be ding a, na zahngaihna leh na thutak ziak in na min ka phat ding; thil tengteng tung ah na min leh na thu na hihlianta ngal a.
english: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

paite: K'on sap ni in nang na hon dawng a, ka hinna na hatna in na hon hihhat hi.
english: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

paite: TOUPA aw, lei a kumpipa tengteng in kipahthu ahon hilh ding ua, na kam a thupawtte azata uhi.
english: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

paite: Ahi, TOUPA lampite la in asa ding ua; TOUPA thupina lah athupi ngal a.
english: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, for Yahweh’s glory is great!

paite: TOUPA tungnungtak ahi na a, mineute alimsak hi; mikisatheite bel gamlapi a kipan in athei hi.
english: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

paite: Mangbatna lak ah vak mah leng nang na hon hihhalh ding a; hon doute hehna sual ding in na khut na zak ding a, na khut taklam in na hon hondam ding hi.
english: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

paite: TOUPA'N ka tungtang a ahih ding atangtun ding; TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding a; nangmah khut thilhihte tawpsan ke'n.
english: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
